assets: canonical runtime scope triple per ArtifactVersion
immutable ArtifactVersion content and version chain
append-only operation and lineage event log
actors: attacker (forges scope, mutates history, injects orphan/cyclic edges, tampers metrics)
auditor (rebuilds chains from canonical events only)
trust_boundaries: caller scope claim -> canonical auth context (caller strings never widen scope)
runtime state -> export projection (projection never flows back as authority)
visible scope -> redacted foreign scope (no content/IDs cross)

threats.description: cross-scope copy mutates the source located_in
lineage edge points at a missing entity/member
one ArtifactVersion carries two authoritative scopes
forged/cyclic/out-of-order causal graph accepted without explicit policy
stale ID or reused member silently binds to a new entity
PROV export loses a removal or membership interval
importer collapses immutable versions or rewrites scope
partial cross-scope move presents as completed
unknown version, duplicate key, NaN, remote ref or traversal accepted
extra/missing fixture or changed frozen hash accepted

residual_risks: bounded corpus: 48 scenarios cannot cover arbitrary distributed executions
same-host process separation is called replay, not an external audit
wall-clock latencies are same-host model evidence, not production SLOs
redaction receipts expose foreign-entity counts by design (L11 permits counts)
